text_blocks.snippet: An eVisa application is an electronic visa application system allowing travelers to apply for a visa online, often through a government portal. The process typically involves filling out an online form, uploading required documents, and making an online payment. After successful processing, the eVisa is usually sent via email.
snippet_highlighted_words: an electronic visa application system allowing travelers to apply for a visa online, often through a government portal

list.title: Gather Documents:
